description: This file defines the CanvasWindowController class responsible for managing a web view-based canvas within a macOS application. It handles loading URLs, managing session directories, injecting JavaScript bridges, and coordinating UI interactions for the canvas view.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A macOS window controller that embeds and manages a WKWebView for rendering a web-based canvas. It handles session management, URL loading, JavaScript injection, and interactions with the canvas content.

methods.name: applyPreferredPlacement
methods.description: Sets the preferred placement of the canvas window.

methods.name: showCanvas
methods.description: Displays the canvas window, optionally loading a specific path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the specified target URL or file path into the web view.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display with optional title and subtitle.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status settings to the web view.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a local file URL into the web view with proper read access.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the web view and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current web view content and saves it as a PNG file.

methods.name: shouldAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Determines if navigation to A2UI should automatically occur based on current and last targets.
